Name: Optimized Mining Map
Author: ActionJackson22
Description:
Improves a number of various aspects of the Mining Farm map.

[list=1]
[*]Removes the hill on the mid right part of the farm
[*]Increased cliff space for shed and greenhouse placement
[*]Added entrance/exit to top of mining area
[*]Increased path space in upper left so you can get through on your horse
[/list]
This mod works best with a new farm, but will work with an existing save. If you load up an existing save with this mod you will have some bushes in the way of the new entrance/exit placed in the mining area. To remove these bushes, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] and use the CONSOLE (the SMAPI window that shows up before the modded game loads) command "remove_bush" on the bushes there. You can remove [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] after you remove the bushes and save your game. DO NOT USE RESET TERRAIN FEATURES IT COULD BREAK YOUR SAVE.
